candidates.classification: source-derived conditional partial inventory insertion and false success caused by erased positive-grant error; product execution unverified
candidates.detail: Assume a positive generic request for an item ID absent from both the Item table and the food catalog, with no preexisting matching inventory row. The nonmeasured branch calls add_inventory_item. Its checked helper accepts the missing definition through inventory_food_definition, inserts an InventoryItem row, then initialize_personal_weapon returns an unknown-definition error. The wrapper converts that error to None via .ok().flatten(), while the reducer ignores the None and returns Ok. Pinned SpacetimeDB documentation says a successful reducer commits its transaction, so source predicts a committed unknown-item row and false success for these premises. No reducer or database was run.
candidates.safeguards: Measured positive additions propagate a missing result as an error; the checked helper propagates internal failures when its Result is actually used. The example assumes an absent item and food definition, no existing matching row and a live character; it does not demonstrate a deployed malformed row or all grant paths. Native transaction behavior is documented source, not observed runtime evidence.
